head: 70092ba68794b8c4ef905f64e0f676887d9ef703
authority: Re-review only the two R2 rejection gaps, the fresh packer/new-test increment, and bind the same seven files. No source edits, historical report edits, old-355 rerun, network, device work, secret access, commit or push. Only this new review report is written.

checks.basis: The existing inert-owner plus unrelated require fixture and wrong-order wrapper fixture now reject; current three-argument lazy wrapper and explicit import aliases pass. However ownerHas still treats any lexical object property named _elctonWearCompat as the app owner, without proving its object is the exported app. The independent decoy-property probe below still accepts a disconnected actual owner.

Missing map rejects before packaging. Original source/content arrays must exist, have equal lengths, and every sourcesContent value must be a string. New null, missing-content and no-map cases reject; retained original Unicode/newline/NUL string content is verified verbatim.

findings.requirement: The actual exported app _elctonWearCompat must link/delegate to the selected complete factory; unrelated properties must not attest app ownership.
findings.finding: ownerHas collects all lexical _elctonWearCompat properties and returns true on the first factory-linked property. An unrelated local object's valid property therefore attests the app even when exports.default._elctonWearCompat is inert. Lexical binding resolution and ordered wrapper arguments do not bind that property to the actual app export.

independent_reproduction.fixture: Identical full compat factories in app/page, complete string includeSources map, only the synthetic app module body changed to the minimal body above.

findings.minimal_resolution: Select _elctonWearCompat from the actual exported app object (resolving the supported export/object aliases), then apply the existing factory-linkage and exact three-argument checks only to that owner. Add the decoy lexical-property counterexample to NEW tests; reject ambiguous or unproven export ownership. No source factory, old gates or original tests need changes.
findings.verification: The minimal unrelated-object plus inert exports.default fixture must reject while the real lazy owner and supported compiled export shapes remain accepted.

inherited_preserved_invariants.basis: R2 source/body/routing approvals are carried forward by equality of the five unchanged scope hashes, not reopened. Only packer and NEW sharing test hashes differ.

native_boundary: All new rejection tests and the independent failure probe are synthetic QA only. They are not actual SDK/native evidence. New actual SDK parse verification remains pending parent CI; no parse/OOM repair, handshake or device success is claimed.
disposition: BLOCKED on the single independently reproduced remaining actual-owner linkage gap. Missing/null includeSources rejection is fixed. Recorded author and parent R3 green totals are 56, not 54/55. Stop after this report; do not broaden scope.
